stories.headline: AMD Q1 Revenue Up 38% to $10.25B; Data Center Jumps 57% to $5.8B; Q2 Guidance Beats Estimates

key_facts.fact: AMD Q1 revenue was $10.25 billion, up 38% YoY from $7.44 billion, beating the $9.89 billion consensus estimate
Data Center segment revenue was $5.8 billion, up 57% YoY from $3.67 billion, above the $5.64 billion estimate
AMD guided Q2 revenue of approximately $11.2 billion, well above the $10.52 billion consensus estimate
Adjusted EPS was $1.37, up 43% YoY from $0.96, beating the $1.29 consensus estimate
AMD now expects the server CPU addressable market to grow at greater than 35% annually, reaching over $120 billion by 2030, up from a prior 18% growth forecast
CEO Lisa Su said the company has 'strong and increasing confidence' in reaching tens of billions in data center AI revenue next year and exceeding 80% long-term growth target
Client and Gaming revenue grew 23% to $3.6 billion despite lower semi-custom revenue for game consoles

stories.headline: Anthropic Releases 10 AI Agent Templates for Financial Services, From Pitch Decks to KYC

key_facts.fact: Anthropic released 10 ready-to-run agent templates for financial services tasks including building pitchbooks, KYC screening, earnings review, and month-end close
Each agent template ships as a plugin in Claude Cowork and Claude Code, or as cookbooks for Claude Managed Agents, enabling deployment in days rather than months
Claude now works across Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook through new add-ins for Microsoft 365, with context carrying automatically between applications
Claude Opus 4.7 leads the industry on Vals AI's Finance Agent benchmark at 64.37%
Financial services is Anthropic's second-highest revenue-contributing industry; the launch came one day after Anthropic's $1.5B joint venture with Blackstone and Goldman Sachs
Customer deployments cited include AIG, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, IG Group, and Moody's

stories.headline: Anthropic Commits to Spending $200B on Google Cloud and Chips Over Five Years

key_facts.fact: Anthropic has committed to spend $200 billion with Google Cloud over five years as part of a recent agreement, according to The Information
The commitment accounts for more than 40% of the revenue backlog Google disclosed to investors last week
Contracts from Anthropic and OpenAI now account for more than half of the $2 trillion in backlogs at major cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
Anthropic signed a deal in April with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of TPU capacity expected online starting 2027; Broadcom's SEC filing cited approximately 3.5 GW
Alphabet is also investing up to $40 billion in Anthropic, deepening its partnership with the AI startup
Alphabet is on the cusp of overtaking Nvidia as the world's most valuable company; the gap narrowed to ~$96 billion on May 5

stories.headline: Apple to Let iOS 27 Users Choose Third-Party AI Models Across Writing Tools, Siri, and More

key_facts.fact: Apple plans to let users select from multiple third-party AI models for tasks like generating and editing text and images in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27 this fall
The feature is internally called 'Extensions,' allowing users to access AI capabilities from installed apps through Siri, Writing Tools, Image Playground, and more
Apple has been internally testing integrations with at least Google's Gemini and Anthropic's Claude, in addition to the existing ChatGPT integration
Users will be able to assign different Siri voices when conversing with external AI models vs. in-house Siri
A dedicated App Store section will list compatible AI apps; providers opt in by adding compatibility through their App Store applications

stories.headline: DeepSeek Nears $45B Valuation as China's Big Fund Seeks to Lead First Fundraise

key_facts.fact: China Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund (the 'Big Fund') is in talks to lead DeepSeek's first-ever fundraising round at a ~$45 billion valuation
DeepSeek's valuation has surged from ~$20 billion expected just weeks earlier when fundraising talks began
Other investors still in talks include Tencent and Alibaba; founder Liang Wenfeng may also invest personal funds in the round
The Big Fund has previously backed SMIC and Yangtze Memory Technologies but has not publicly backed any LLM developer before
DeepSeek has never raised external funding before; founder Liang Wenfeng currently controls the company through personal holdings and affiliated entities

organizations: China Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund

stories.headline: Von der Leyen Tells Trump 'A Deal Is a Deal' as EU Unites Against Car Tariff Threat

key_facts.fact: European Commission President von der Leyen spoke out for the first time since Trump's Friday announcement of 25% tariffs on EU cars, stating flatly that 'a deal is a deal.'
French President Macron explicitly backed retaliation, saying 'the EU has the tools to respond, and should use them, because that's what they are for.'

Under the Turnberry accord struck last July, US tariffs on EU cars were set at 15%. In exchange, the EU agreed to lower industrial tariffs, purchase $750 billion in US energy, and invest $600 billion in the American economy.
EU Trade Commissioner Šefčovič met US Trade Representative Greer in Paris on Tuesday to try to steady talks after Trump's tariff threat.
European Council President António Costa said EU leaders 'fully support' the Commission's response to Trump's trade threat.

stories.headline: Freshworks Cuts 11% of Workforce (~500 Jobs) as CEO Says 'Over Half of Code Is Written by AI'

key_facts.fact: Freshworks announced it would cut 11% of its workforce, about 500 jobs globally, citing AI-driven automation as a key driver. One-time restructuring charges of ~$8 million are expected.
CEO Dennis Woodside told Reuters the decision was driven by AI use in product and engineering: 'Over half of our code is written by AI,' reducing 'rote work that technology can take care of.'
The cuts follow Atlassian slashing roughly 10% of jobs last month. AI tools from Anthropic and others are seen as potential existential threats to traditional software makers.
Freshworks' stock has declined about 26% in 2026. Despite the cuts, Q1 revenue rose 16% to $228.6 million, beating estimates of $223.24 million.
Layoffs.fyi reports that 92,462 tech employees globally have lost their jobs in 2026 so far. This is Freshworks' second restructuring in two years, after cutting 13% of staff in 2024.

stories.headline: GlobalFoundries Q1 Gross Margin Hits Record 29% as AI Optical Networking Revenue Surges 32% YoY

key_facts.fact: GlobalFoundries Q1 revenue was $1.634 billion, up 3% YoY, at the high end of guidance; all Non-IFRS profitability metrics at or above the high end of guidance
Non-IFRS gross margin hit a first-quarter record of 29.0%, expanding 510 basis points YoY — the largest expansion in three years
Communications Infrastructure & Data Center (CID) segment grew 32% YoY to $230 million, its sixth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth
Management raised full-year CID growth outlook to the high 30% range from approximately 30% previously; design wins increased 50% YoY
Q2 guidance of $1.76 billion revenue ±$20 million exceeded the $1.74 billion estimate; adjusted EPS of $0.40 beat the $0.35 estimate
GFS shares closed up 9.28% on the day; Automotive revenue rose 24% YoY to $382 million

stories.headline: Google Tests 'Remy' 24/7 AI Agent for Gemini, Quietly Shuts Down Project Mariner

key_facts.fact: Google is internally testing an AI agent codenamed 'Remy' that runs in a staff-only version of the Gemini app and integrates with Google services
Remy can monitor things that matter to users, handle complex tasks proactively, and learn preferences over time, positioning it as Google's answer to OpenClaw
Google quietly shut down Project Mariner on May 5, the Chrome-browsing AI agent it highlighted onstage at I/O 2025
Google had previously moved staffers off the Project Mariner team as it pivoted toward OpenClaw-style agents, per WIRED reporting from ~2 months earlier
Google's I/O event is scheduled for May 19-20, where agents are expected to be a major focus; CEO Demis Hassabis has long outlined a vision for building a digital assistant

stories.headline: Infineon Raises FY2026 Outlook as AI Data Center Power Chip Revenue Surges to €1.5B, Eyes €2.5B in 2027

key_facts.fact: Infineon posted Q2 revenue of €3.81 billion, up 6% YoY, and raised its full-year guidance from moderate to significant revenue growth
Infineon expects AI data center revenue of approximately €1.5 billion in FY2026, rising to approximately €2.5 billion in FY2027
Infineon raised its 2026 segment result margin target to around 20% from the previously expected high-teens percent range
CEO Jochen Hanebeck said 'The AI boom strengthens further, and our power supply solutions for AI data centers are in very high demand'
Infineon is boosting FY2026 manufacturing investments by €500 million to €2.7 billion overall to meet AI data center demand
Net income rose to €301 million from €232 million YoY; Q3 revenue guided at €4.1 billion

stories.headline: Meta Builds OpenClaw-Inspired 'Hatch' AI Agent, Plans Instagram Shopping Tool Before Q4

key_facts.fact: Meta is developing a consumer AI agent internally codenamed 'Hatch,' inspired by OpenClaw, targeting internal testing completion by end of June
Hatch is currently powered by Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 models, but will switch to Meta's own Muse Spark model at launch
Meta built virtual environments modeled on real websites like DoorDash, Etsy, and Reddit to safely test Hatch's capabilities
Separately, Meta plans an agentic shopping tool for Instagram, targeting launch before Q4, to compete with TikTok Shop
Meta raised its AI infrastructure capex this year to as much as $145 billion; CEO Zuckerberg said the goal is to 'build agents that understand your goals and work around the clock'
Meta tried to acquire OpenClaw but was outbid by OpenAI; it also faces potential cancellation of its Manus acquisition after Chinese authorities intervened

stories.headline: Micron Ships 245TB SSD, World's Highest-Capacity Drive; Market Cap Crosses $700B for First Time

key_facts.fact: Micron began shipping its 245TB Micron 6600 ION SSD, billed as the world's highest-capacity commercially available solid-state drive
Micron shares surged 11%, lifting its market cap past $700 billion for the first time; the stock is up 124% YTD and nearly 700% in 12 months
The 245TB SSD requires 82% fewer racks to achieve equivalent raw storage compared to HDD-based racks, addressing power constraints in AI data centers
Gartner projects global memory revenue will nearly triple from $216.3 billion in 2025 to $633.3 billion in 2026, with DRAM prices spiking 125% and NAND 234%
Sandisk also jumped 12% to an all-time high; Intel neared a $550 billion valuation after a 13% pop, surpassing its dotcom-era value
Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra previously said key customers are only getting 50% to two-thirds of their memory requirements due to the supply crunch

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.5 Instant as ChatGPT's Default Model, Claims 52% Fewer Hallucinations

key_facts.fact: GPT-5.5 Instant replaces GPT-5.3 Instant as ChatGPT's default model, rolling out to all users starting May 5
In internal evaluations, GPT-5.5 Instant produced 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims than GPT-5.3 Instant on high-stakes prompts in medicine, law, and finance
The model reduced inaccurate claims by 37.3% on especially challenging conversations users had flagged for factual errors
GPT-5.5 Instant scored 81.2 on the AIME 2025 math test vs 65.4 for GPT-5.3 Instant, and 76 vs 69.2 on MMMU-Pro multimodal reasoning
Enhanced personalization uses past chats, files, and connected Gmail to tailor responses; rolling out first to Plus and Pro users on web
GPT-5.3 Instant will remain available for paid users for three months before being retired; the model is also available via API as 'gpt-5.5-chat-latest'

stories.headline: Samsung Reaches $1 Trillion Valuation, Only Second Asian Company After TSMC to Hit Mark

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics reached a market valuation of 1,500 trillion won (~$1.03 trillion) in Seoul trading on May 6, as shares soared 14.4% to an all-time high.
Samsung became only the second Asian company after TSMC to reach the $1 trillion market cap milestone, and the 13th company globally to join the 'trillion club.'
The rally pushed South Korea's Kospi benchmark above the 7,000 level for the first time, with the index surging 6.45% to close at 7,384.56.
Samsung's stock has risen around 300% over the past year, driven by booming AI chip demand. The company reported record Q1 operating profit surging 750% YoY to 57.2 trillion won (~$39.3B).
SK Hynix also hit a record high, leaping 10.6%. Samsung and SK Hynix together account for 44% of the Kospi's total value.

stories.headline: SpaceX Proposes $55B Terafab Semiconductor Facility in Texas, Total Capex Could Reach $119B

key_facts.fact: SpaceX is proposing to spend $55 billion to begin construction of a next-generation, vertically integrated semiconductor manufacturing and advanced computing fabrication facility in Grimes County, Texas
The estimated total capital investment could rise to $119 billion if additional phases of the project are completed
The facility would be located at the Gibbons Creek Reservoir and surrounding areas in Grimes County, approximately 20 miles east of Bryan-College Station
Grimes County Commissioners Court will hold a public hearing on June 3, 2026 to consider approval of a property tax abatement agreement for SpaceX
The project involves a designated reinvestment zone called 'SpaceX Reinvestment Zone No. 1 - 2026-001'

stories.headline: Super Micro Q3 Revenue Up 123% to $10.24B but Misses Estimates; Strong Q4 Guidance Sends Stock Up 18%

key_facts.fact: Super Micro reported Q3 revenue of $10.24 billion, up 123% YoY from $4.6 billion, but below the $12.33 billion analyst estimate
Adjusted EPS was 84 cents, beating the 62-cent estimate; shares jumped 18% in extended trading
Q4 guidance of $11 billion to $12.5 billion in revenue exceeded the $11.07 billion consensus estimate
CEO Charles Liang said customer readiness delays caused revenue shortfall — several customers lacked power and networking for cloud deployments
Full-year fiscal 2026 revenue outlook lifted to $38.9 billion to $40.4 billion
The board is conducting an independent review of certain transactions tied to export-control issues after associates were charged with illegally diverting Nvidia servers to China

stories.headline: Thailand Approves $12.2B Emergency Loan Decree to Cushion Hormuz-Driven Energy Crisis

key_facts.fact: Thailand's Cabinet approved a draft emergency decree to borrow up to 400 billion baht (~$12.2 billion), aimed at cushioning economic impacts from the global energy crisis and accelerating clean energy transition.
PM Anutin said the decision was driven by the West Asia conflict (Hormuz disruption), which has cascaded from energy into food prices, putting significant pressure on the cost of living.

Phase 1 provides immediate financial relief to farmers, SMEs, and low- to middle-income citizens. Phase 2 targets long-term transformation by reducing fossil fuel reliance and promoting renewables and EVs.
The government aims to prevent Thailand from sliding into stagflation — high inflation combined with a slowing economy. National debt will remain below the 70% of GDP legal ceiling.
The emergency decree is scheduled to be submitted to Parliament on May 14.

stories.headline: Trump Pauses Hormuz Reopening, US and Gulf Allies Propose New UN Resolution Threatening Iran

key_facts.fact: Trump announced Tuesday evening he was pausing the U.S. effort to guide stranded vessels out of the Strait of Hormuz to allow time for a deal to end the Iran war, while the blockade of Iranian ports remains in place.

The US drafted a new UN Security Council resolution with Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, and Qatar that could lead to sanctions or potentially authorize force against Iran if it fails to halt attacks on shipping.
Rubio called the resolution 'a real test to the U.N.' and urged China and Russia not to repeat their vetoes of a previous Hormuz resolution last month.
Pentagon chief Hegseth and Gen. Dan Caine said Iran's attacks remain 'below the threshold of restarting major combat operations' and insist the ceasefire still holds.
Caine estimated 22,500 mariners on more than 1,550 commercial vessels remain stuck in the Gulf, unable to transit the strait.
Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi traveled to Beijing on Wednesday to meet Chinese counterpart Wang Yi — the first such visit since the start of the war.
Washington also circulated a proposal for a new multinational Maritime Freedom Construct (MFC) to establish a post-conflict security architecture for the Middle East.

stories.headline: Ukraine Doubles Medium-Range Drone Strikes, Hits Russian Defense Factories 1,500 km Away

key_facts.fact: Zelenskiy said on Tuesday that Ukrainian medium-range drone strikes at ranges of more than 20 km have doubled compared to March and quadrupled since February, calling it 'a priority area.'
Ukraine's Defence Ministry said forces conducted more than 160 medium-range strikes in April at ranges of 120-150 km, hitting 65+ logistics depots, 33 drone control points, and 17 command posts.
Zelenskiy said Ukraine hit Russian military-industrial sites including defense manufacturing facilities in Cheboksary, 1,500 km away, using domestically developed Flamingo cruise missiles.
Ukraine's drone forces commander said his units struck 25 air-defense and 13 radar/electronic warfare systems in April to 'open corridors for ramping up deep strikes.'
The campaign aims to reduce reliance on Western aid as Ukraine develops its homegrown defense sector, while Russian forces increase pressure on key fortified cities in eastern Ukraine.
